¹¹ Since Malkhut
¹² As explained above, the level of Ḥokhma


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 4:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/4:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/4:8)


ומחמת עלית המלכות לנקבי העינים נמתקה שם מאד, ונעשתה ראויה אח"כ לעלות ולהלביש או"א עילאין, ולקבל מוחין שהם מוחין דחיה כמו אמא עילאה. וה"ס סיהרא באשלמותא. ולפיכך במתן תורה הקדימו ישראל נעשה לנשמע, והקדימו עשיה לשמיעה, שבזה זכו לקבלת התורה.(שבת פח:)כי העשיה שהיא מלכות עלתה והלבישה את או"א עילאין ונגלה סוד היובל, שער הנון.


On account of the ascent of the *Malkhut* to the apertures of the eyes, she became greatly tempered there, and she subsequently became fit to ascend and enclothe the *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*, and to receive the brains, which are the brains¹³. In this context, since *Malkhut* ascended and became fit to enclothe *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*, *Malkhut* now has access to the light of *Ḥokhma* to which *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in* have access. of *ḥaya*, like the [the *partzuf*] of the supernal mother. This is the mystical meaning of the moon in its fullness.¹⁴ was diminished when it was paired with *Ze'er Anpin* initially, but through this process, *Malkhut* regains access to the supernal light and returns to its "fullness." Therefore, at the giving of the Torah, Israel said “we will do” before “we will hear,” and [thus] they made “doing” precede “hearing.” They thereby merited to receive the Torah [see *Shabbat* 89b]. The “doing,” which is *Malkhut*, ascended and enclothed the *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*, and the mystical meaning of the Jubilee was revealed, which is the fiftieth gate.¹⁵, accessed during the spiritual process at Mount Sinai during the giving of the Torah.

footnotes:
¹³ Generally, "brains" refers to a particular level of supernal light of Ḥokhma
¹⁴ Malkhut
¹⁵ This is a reference to the fifty gates of Bina


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 4:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/4:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/4:9)


וזה אמרו כאן, שלכן היתה השמיעה ביום הששי, כי בו נעשה התיקון הזה להקדים עשיה לשמיעה. כמו במתן תורה, וע"כ נעשתה המלכות בשבת בראשית בבחינת ארץ החיים, שה"ס אמא עילאה. כמו שמבאר והולך. וענין זה עמוק מאד, ועי' כאן במראות הסולם, שהרחבנו ענין זה.


This is the meaning of the statement here that the hearing was therefore on the sixth day, as it was on that [day] that this rectification was performed, to make “doing” precede “hearing,” as at the Giving of the Torah. Consequently, the *Malkhut* on the [first] Shabbat of Creation became like “the land of the living,” which is the mystical meaning of the [*partzuf* of the] supernal mother, as [Rabbi Shimon] proceeds to explain. This topic is extremely profound; see the *Marot HaSulam* here, where we elaborate on this matter.


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 4:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/4:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/4:10)


**בארצנו דא יום שבת, דאיהו דוגמת ארץ החיים**: אמא עילאה נק' ארץ החיים. וע"י השפעת יום הששי, עלתה הנוקבא ביום שבת דמעשה בראשית עד אמא עלאה, ונעשתה גם הנוקבא דוגמת ארץ החיים. כי זה הכלל אם התחתון עולה לעליון ממנו נעשה כמוהו ממש.


**“In our land – this is the day of Shabbat, which is like the land of the living.”** The supernal mother is called “the land of the living.” By means of that which was bestowed on the sixth day, the *Nukba* ascended on the Shabbat of *Bereshit*, [the seventh day of Creation] up to the supernal mother, and the *Nukba* also became like the land of the living. For this is the rule – if a lower entity ascends to a higher one, it becomes exactly like it.


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:1)


ה) **ד"א הנצנים אלין** וכו': פירוש אחר. **הנצנים**, אלו הם האבות שנכנסו במחשבה, ונכנסו בעולם הבא, שהוא בינה, ונגנזו שם. ומשם יצאו בגניזו, ונסתרו תוך נביאי האמת. נולד יוסף ונסתרו בו. נכנס יוסף בארץ הקדושה, והקים אותם שם, ואז **נראו בארץ** ונגלו שם. ומתי הם נראים. היינו בשעה שהקשת נראית בעולם. כי בשעה שהקשת נראית, אז הם מתגלים. ובאותה שעה, **עת הזמיר הגיע**, היינו, עת לקצץ את הרשעים מן העולם. למה נצולו. היינו משום שהנצנים נראו בארץ. ואם לא היו נראים מכבר, לא היו נשארים בעולם, והעולם לא היה מתקיים.


**5. An alternative explanation: The flowers, these are etc.**
**An alternative explanation: “The flowers”** [Song of Songs 2:12] – **these are the Patriarchs, who entered into thought and entered into the World-to-Come,** which is *Bina*, **and were concealed there. From there, they emerged in concealment and were hidden in the true prophets. Joseph was born, and they were hidden in him. Joseph entered the Holy Land and established them there, and then they “appeared on the earth” and were revealed there. When are** they **seen? When the rainbow is seen in the world. For when the rainbow is seen in the world, then they are revealed. And at that hour, “the time of pruning has come,”** that is, **the time to chop off the wicked from the world. Why were they spared? Because “the flowers appeared on the earth.” Had they not appeared already, they would not have remained in the world, and the world would not have survived.**


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:2)


ביאור הדברים, כאן מבאר את הכתוב הנ"ל, על בחינת השגת מוחין דחיה של ז"א גופיה. ואומר, שהנצנים סובבים על חג"ת דז"א, שנק' אבהן, כי הנה"י דז"א נק' בנין, והם ב' פרצופין, הנחלקין על החזה של הז"א, כי חג"ת נק' זו"ן הגדולים, ונה"י נק' זו"ן הקטנים. וע"כ מדייק להשמיענו שהוא מז"א הגדול, וע"כ אומר, **אבהן**. ונק' בשם **נצנים**, שפירושו נטיעות, הוא, מפני שהולכים וגדלים כדרך נטיעות. שמתחילה היתה מדתם כמו נה"י, ואח"כ ביניקה נעשו חג"ת, ואח"כ בגדלות א', נעשו חב"ד של נשמה. ואח"כ בגדלות ב', נעשו חב"ד דחיה.


Explanation: Here [Rabbi Shimon] explains the verse cited above, with regard to the attainment of the brains of *ḥaya* of *Ze’er Anpin* itself. He says that the flowers surround *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* of *Ze’er Anpin*, which are called the Patriarchs. For the *Netzaḥ*, *Hod*, and *Yesod* of *Ze’er Anpin* are called “sons,” and they¹ each represent one *partzuf* structure. are two *partzufim* that are split apart on the chest of *Ze’er Anpin*, since *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* are called the large [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*, while *Netzaḥ*, *Hod*, and *Yesod* are called the small [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*. [Rabbi Shimon] is therefore precise in telling us that [he is discussing] the large [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*, which is why he says **“Patriarchs.”** They are called “flowers,” which means sprouts, because they progressively grow, like sprouts. Their level was initially like *Netzaḥ*, *Hod*, and *Yesod*, and subsequently they became [of the level of] *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet*, through the drawing in [of light in infancy], after which, in the first maturity, they became [the level of] *Ḥokhma*, *Bina*, and *Da'at* of *neshama*, and then, in the second maturity, they became *Ḥokhma*, *Bina*, and *Da'at* of *ḥaya*.² is describing four phases in the development of *Ze'er Anpin*, represented by each of the four structures of *sefirot* mentioned here.

footnotes:
¹ These two groupings of sefirot
² The author of the Sulam


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:3)


וז"ש **דעאלו במחשבה ועאלו בעלמא דאתי**: הכונה היא על עיבורו של ז"א, כי בעת עיבורו הוא עולה לאו"א הנק' מחשבה ועלמא דאתי, אבא נק' מחשבה, ואמא נק' עלמא דאתי, ושם ראשית בנינו של הז"א בבחינת ג' גו ג', שפירושו שהחג"ת מלובשים תוך הנה"י. וז"ס הנטיעות כקרני חגבים היו, עקרן משם ושתלן במקום אחר והגדילו. הנטיעות הן אבהן כנ"ל, שהן חג"ת משרשן, וע"י עליתן לעיבור לחו"ב, דהיינו ששתלן במקום אחר, והשיגו שם את המלכות הממותקת הראויה למוחין לעת גדלות. הנה עי"ז גדלו לאט לאט, ע"י העיבור, אח"כ ע"י יניקה אח"כ ע"י גדלות א' ולבסוף ע"י הגדלות הב', כמו שמבאר והולך. וז"ש **ומתמן נפקו בגניזו**: שאחר שקבלו החג"ת כל המוחין דעיבור, הם נולדים ויוצאים מאו"א למקומם למטה, **ונפקי בגניזו**, כי גם אחר יציאתם מאו"א למקומם נשארו עוד בגניזו, דהיינו באור מועט.


He then states: **“Entered in thought and entered into the World-to-Come.”** This is referring to the gestation³ in the *partzufim* of *Atzilut*. In this phase, the *sefirot* of *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* of *Ze'er Anpin* are embedded inside of the lower *sefirot* of *Netzaḥ*, *Hod*, and *Yesod*, "gestating" within them. of *Ze’er Anpin*, since at the time of its gestation it ascends to *Abba* and *Imma* (father and mother),⁴ of *Bina*, the *partzuf* that gives the aspects of *Ze'er Anpin* access to the supernal light of *Ḥokhma* when *Ze'er Anpin* ascends to receive it. which is called “thought” and “the World-to-Come”; the father is called “thought” and the mother is called “the World-to-Come.” The beginning of the construction of *Ze’er Anpin* in “three within three” occurs there, meaning that that *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* are enclothed within *Netzaḥ*, *Hod*, and *Yesod*. This is the mystical meaning of [the statement]: “The sprouts were like antenna of grasshoppers” – they were uprooted from there, planted elsewhere, and grew. The plantings are the Patriarchs, as stated, who, at their root, are *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet*. Through their ascent for purposes of gestation into *Ḥokhma* and *Bina*, that is, when they are planted elsewhere, these [aspects of *Ze'er Anpin*] obtained there the tempered *Malkhut*, which is fit for brains at the time of maturity.⁵ of *Ze'er Anpin* to receive the "brains," the lights of *Ḥokhma*. This also requires a "tempering" of *Malkhut* of *Ze'er Anpin* through a complex process, since the presence of the first constriction upon *Malkhut* repels the light of *Ḥokhma*. They thereby grew slowly through gestation, and subsequently through infancy, and then through the first maturity, and finally through the second maturity, as [Rabbi Shimon] proceeds to explain. The meaning of **“from there, they emerged in concealment”** is that after *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* receive all the brains of gestation, they are born and emerge from *Abba* and *Imma*⁶ to *Abba* and *Imma* marks the gestation phase in which the *sefirot* of *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* ultimately emerge from *Netzaḥ*, *Hod*, and *Yesod*. At this point, *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* gain access to an increased amount of the light of giving, the "brains" of that level which is the light of *ruaḥ*. The *partzuf* of *Ze'er Anpin* is still not complete at this point, so the light is still "diminished." to their place below, **“and emerge in concealment,”** since even after their emergence from *Abba* and *Imma* to their place they still remained in concealment, that is, in diminished light.

footnotes:
³ This refers to the first of four phases in the evolution of Ze'er Anpin
⁴ This refers to the first three sefirot
⁵ The purpose of these phases of gestation, infancy and maturity (which has two phases itself) is to develop the partzuf
⁶ The ascent of Ze'er Anpin


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:4)


וז"ש **ואטמירו גו נביאי קשוט**: כלומר, על ידי השגת מוחין דיניקה, נמשך האור המיוחד אל ספי' נה"י דז"א, הנק' **נביאי קשוט**, ואז נתפשטו להם החג"ת מתוך הנה"י, והשיג ו"ק, ועכ"ז הם עוד בטמירו, כי נמצאים עוד בהעלם מוחין דראש, ואין להם אלא נפש רוח בלבד. וז"ש **ואטמירו גו נביאי קשוט** נביאי קשוט, הם נו"ה שהשיגו על ידי היניקה, אבל אטמירו בהם, כי האור שלהם נעלם עוד ואינו נגלה. ודע שיש תמיד ערך הפוך מכלים לאורות, כי בהתחשב עם בחינת האורות, משיגים ע"י יניקה, אור דחג"ת שהוא רוח, ובהתחשב עם בחי' הכלים, משיגים ביניקה כלים דנו"ה, ואור הנפש שהיה בחג"ת, יורד בהם. וכן במוחין דגדלות שמבחי' האורות, נבחן, שהם משיגין אור דחב"ד, ומבחי' הכלים נבחן שהשיגו כלי היסוד דגדלות, כמ"ש להלן.


[Rabbi Shimon] continues: **“And were hidden in the true prophets.”** In other words, through the attainment of the brains of infancy, the designated light is drawn to the *sefirot* of *Netzaḥ*, *Hod*, and *Yesod* of *Ze’er Anpin*, which are called **“the true prophets.** Then the *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* spread forth from the *Netzaḥ*, *Hod*, and *Yesod*, and *Ze'er Anpin* attained the six extremities. And yet, [the six extremities] remain hidden, as they are still concealed from the [the first three *sefirot*, which are the] brains of the head, and they have only [the lights of] *nefesh* and *ruaḥ* alone. This is why [Rabbi Shimon] stated **“and were hidden within the true prophets.”** The true prophets are *Netzaḥ* and *Hod*, [the vessels] that were attained through infancy, but [the Patriarchs] were hidden in them and their light was still concealed and not revealed. Know that there is always an inverse relation between vessels and lights. This is because in the case of the lights, the light of *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet*, which is *ruaḥ*, is attained through infancy, whereas in the case of the vessels, the vessels of *Netzaḥ* and *Hod* are attained through infancy, and the light of *nefesh* that was in *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet*, descends in them.⁷. Additionally, the light populating that lone vessel would be the light of *nefesh*, the lowest light. Similarly, with regard to the brains of maturity,⁸ in relation to the lights, it is considered that the lights of *Ḥokhma*, *Bina*, and *Da'at* have been attained, whereas in relation to the vessels, it is considered that the vessel of *Yesod* of maturity has been attained, as stated below.

footnotes:
⁷ Here the Sulam references a core principle in spiritual mechanics. Kabbalah structures revolve around the linked constructs of "vessels" and "lights." There are five main vessels corresponding to five main lights. The point here is that the process of development of these two groups has an inverse relationship. Vessels always develop from the highest level of vessel and downward, with the lowest vessel developing last. In contrast, lights populate the existing vessels from the lowest light and upward, with the highest light entering the vessel structure last. This means that if there is only one vessel developed in a structure, it will be the highest vessel, that of Keter
⁸ This refers to the next level above infancy of lights in the development process, the brains of maturity.


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:5)


וז"ש, **אתיליד יוסף ואטמירו ביה**: כי אחר תשלום המוחין דיניקה עולה ז"א לעיבור ב' למוחין דגדלות א', שע"י מוחין אלו נעשו החג"ת שלו לבחינת חב"ד וראש, ונה"י שקנה ע"י היניקה נעשו לו לחג"ת, ונולדים לו נה"י חדשים המכונים נה"י של מוחין דגדלות, ואלו נה"י מכונים בשם יוסף, שהוא יסוד דגדלות הכולל נו"ה דגדלות. וז"ש **אתיליד יוסף**, דהיינו היסוד דגדלות.


This [preceding statement] is what [Rabbi Shimon] meant when he said: **“Joseph was born, and they were hidden in him.”** After the completion of the brains of infancy, *Ze’er Anpin* ascends for a second gestation for the brains of the first maturity. Through these brains, [*Ze'er Anpin*'s infancy,] *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* become *Ḥokhma*, *Bina*, and *Da'at*, [forming] the head [of *Ze'er Anpin*], and the *Netzaḥ*, *Hod*, and *Yesod* that [*Ze'er Anpin*] acquired through infancy become *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* for [the *Ze'er Anpin*]. New [vessels of] *Netzaḥ*, *Hod*, and *Yesod* are born, which are called “*Netzaḥ*, *Hod*, and *Yesod* of the brains of maturity.” Those [*sefirot* of] *Netzaḥ*, *Hod*, and *Yesod* are called Joseph, who is the *Yesod* of maturity, which incorporates *Netzaḥ* and *Hod* of maturity. This is the meaning of **“Joseph was born,”** i.e., the *Yesod* of maturity.


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 5:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:6)


ואומר **ואטמירו ביה**, להשמיענו שעדיין אין להם לחג"ת האורות דגדלות בשלימות, ועדיין הם בהעלם, כי בגדלות א' הוא משיג רק המוחין דנשמה, שהם נבחנים עוד לבחינת אחורים אצל הז"א, וע"כ אומר **ואטמירו ביה**, כלומר, עוד הם בהעלם.


[Rabbi Shimon] says **“and they were hidden in him”** to teach us that *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* still do not have the complete lights of maturity and they remain in concealment [from the complete lights]. This is because in the first maturity *Ze'er Anpin* obtains only the brains of *neshama*, which are still considered the back⁹ in relation to *Ze’er Anpin*. He therefore says that **“they were hidden in him,”** i.e., they remained in concealment.

footnotes:
⁹ In this context, the term "back" indicates a comparative lack of importance, like when a person carelessly tosses something behind him.


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 5:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:7)


וז"ש, **עאל יוסף בארעא קדישא ונציב לון**: כי אחר מוחין דגדלות א' מתחיל הז"א לקבל מוחין דגדלות ב' שהוא מוחין דחיה, ואז ננסרת הנוקבא ממנו ונבנית לפרצוף שלם במוחין דחיה, ואז נקראת הנוקבא **ארעא קדישא** כי המוחין דחיה נק' קודש. והוא שאומר **עאל יוסף** שהוא יסוד דגדלות של הז"א **בארעא קדישא** שהיא הנוקבא פב"פ עם הז"א בקומה שוה. וז"ש, **ונציב לון תמן**: בארעא קדישא דייקא, כי אין המוחין דחיה, שה"ס חכמה, נמשכים רק בעת הזווג, שהזו"ן ברזא דאחד, והם נשארים רק ברשות הנוקבא, כי רק על ידה נמשכו בעת הזווג, וז"ש ונציב לון תמן, דהיינו בביתא דידה. והטעם כי ערך ז"א כלפי הנוק' כערך או"א עי' כלפי ישסו"ת, וע"כ אין מוחין דחיה שה"ס חכמה, נגלית אלא בנוק' שהוא בחי' ישסו"ת. וז"ש להלן **וכדין נראו בארץ ואתגלו תמן** כלומר, עתה נתגלו במדת הגדלות כראוי, אבל עד עתה נחשבים לטמירין ונעלמים.


[Rabbi Shimon] continues: **“Joseph entered the Holy Land and established them.”** After the brains of the first maturity, *Ze’er Anpin* begins to receive the brains of the second maturity, which are the brains of *ḥaya*. The *Nukba* is subsequently excised from *Ze'er Anpin* and is constructed as a whole *partzuf* with the brains of *ḥaya*. Then, the *Nukba* is called **“the Holy Land,”** because the brains of *ḥaya* are called “holy.” [Rabbi Shimon] thus said that Joseph, who is the *Yesod* of the maturity of *Ze’er Anpin*, **“entered the Holy Land,”** which is the *Nukba*,**[**when it is] face-to-face with *Ze’er Anpin*, at an equal level.¹⁰ is separated from *Ze'er Anpin* and formed into a separate *partzuf*, *Ze'er Anpin* and *Nukba* enter into a state of pairing (like "mating") or "fusion." The *Yesod* of *Ze'er Anpin* conceptually represents the sexual organ of the male, "transmitting" to the female (in this case, *Nukba*). This is the meaning of "Joseph (the *Yesod*) entered the Holy Land (the fully formed *Nukba*). **“And established them there”** means specifically in the "Holy Land," since the brains of *ḥaya*, which is the mystical meaning of *Ḥokhma*, are drawn out only at the time of fusion, when [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* are in the mystical [state of] of oneness. The [brains of *ḥaya*] remain only in the domain of the *Nukba*, since [the *Nukba*] is the cause of the drawing down of [these lights] during the time of copulation. That is why [Rabbi Shimon] states “**and established them there,”** i.e., in her home. The reason [why these lights remain only with *Nukba*] is that the quality of *Ze’er Anpin* with respect to the *Nukba* is like the quality of the *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in* with respect to *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*.¹¹ and *Tevuna* requires the light of *Ḥokhma*, in addition to the light of giving. This *partzuf* is the lower *partzuf* of the level of *Bina* in *Atzilut* (and downward). *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in* generally refers to the upper *partzuf* of *Bina* which, in contrast to *Yisrael Saba* and *Tevuna*, only draws the light of giving. Similarly here, *Nukba* draws the greater light of *Ḥokhma*, the light of *ḥaya*, while *Ze'er Anpin* is more like *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*, drawing relatively more of the light of giving. Consequently, the brains of *ḥaya*, the light of *Ḥokhma*, is revealed only in *Nukba*, which is considered *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* [in relation to *Ze'er Anpin*]. This is the meaning of the ensuing statement, **“and then they appeared on the earth and were revealed there.”** In other words, they are now revealed in the proper quality of maturity, but until now they were considered hidden and concealed.

footnotes:
¹⁰ The imagery here is sexual in nature. As the Nukba
¹¹ Yisrael Saba


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 5:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:8)


ואומר עוד **ואימתי אתחזון** וכו'. ואין לשאול הלא כבר ביאר זאת לעיל שהם מתגלים בשעתא דעאל יוסף בארעא קדישא, דהיינו בעת הזווג, גם השמיענו שמקום ההתגלות הוא בנוקבא, וא"כ מאי שואל עוד הפעם **אימתי אתחזון**. הענין הוא כי גם בעת הזווג ישנן ב' הבחנות, כי יש התכללות שמאלא בימינא דהיינו בסוד ה' חסדים שבזכר, ויש התכללות ימינא בשמאלא בסוד ה' גבורות שבנוקבא. וע"כ שואל אימתי אתחזון, אם בסוד התכללות ימינא בשמאלא, אם בסוד התכללות שמאלא בימינא.


[The *Zohar*] continues: **“When are they seen** etc.” One should not ask: But he already explained this earlier, that they are revealed when Joseph ascends to the Holy Land, that is, at the time of the copulation, and he also informed us that the place of the manifestation is in the *Nukba*, and if so, why does he again ask, **“when are they seen”**? The explanation is that even at the time of the copulation there are two aspects, as there is the incorporation of the left in the right, i.e., in the mystical meaning of the five givings (*ḥassadim*) in the male, and there is the incorporation of the right in the left, in the mystical meaning of the five restraints in the *Nukba*. He therefore asks when they are seen, whether in the mystical meaning of the incorporation of the right in the left, or in the mystical meaning of the incorporation of the left in the right.


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 5:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:9)


ומשיב. **בשעתא דאתגלי קשת בעלמא: קשת**, היא יסוד דז"א, **בעלמא**, הוא הנוקבא, שהיא בחינת התכללות ימינא בשמאלא בעת הזווג, בסוד את קשתי נתתי בענן וכו'. ואומר שרק מבחינה זו נמשכין המוחין העילאין. וז"ש, **כדין אתגליין אינון**, דהיינו רק מבחינת התכללות ימינא בשמאלא.


He answers: **“When the rainbow is seen in the world.** The **“rainbow”** is *Yesod* of *Ze’er Anpin*; **“in the world”** means the *Nukba*, which is the incorporation of the right in the left at the time of the fusion, in the mystical meaning of “I have set My bow in the cloud etc.” [Genesis 9:13]. He is saying that the higher brains are drawn only from that aspect, and this is the meaning of **“then they are revealed,”** i.e., only from the incorporation of the right in the left.


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 5:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:10)


וז"ש, **ובההיא שעתא עת הזמיר הגיע עדן לקצץ חייבין בעלמא**: כלומר בעת שמתרבין הרשעים בעולם, שמחמתם נעשו אחיזה מרובה לקליפות והס"א, ע"ד שהיה בזמן דור המבול, שנמחה מחמת זה כל היקום, הנה אז אין לבני העולם תקנה אלא על ידי הגילוי של מוחין עילאין הנ"ל, שהם המוחין דחיה. כמ"ש והולך. וז"ש, **אמאי אשתזיבו, בגין דהנצנים נראו**: פירוש, למה בני העולם מוצלים מכליה, כמו שהיה בימי המבול, הוא משום דהנצנים נראו בארץ. כי גילוי המוחין דחיה מעביר את הקליפות מהארץ שהיא המלכות, ואינן יכולות להאחז בה עוד. שז"ס הכתוב וראיתיה לזכור ברית עולם.


[Rabbi Shimon] continues: **“And at that hour, the time of pruning has come, the time to chop off the wicked from the world.”** When the wicked multiply in the world, on whose account the *kelippot* and the *Sitra Aḥara* have gained a strong footing, as occurred in the time of the generation of the flood – on account of which every living thing was wiped out – at that stage, the inhabitants of the world have no remedy other than through the revelation of the aforementioned supernal brains, which are the brains of *ḥaya*, as [Rabbi Shimon] proceeds to explain. The clause **“why were they spared – because the flowers appeared”** means the following: Why are people spared destruction, as occurred in the days of the flood? It is because **“**the flowers appeared on the earth.” [This refers to how] the revelation of the brains of *ḥaya* remove the *kelippot* from the earth, which is *Malkhut*, and [the *kelippot*] no longer have a hold upon it. This is the mystical meaning of the verse: “And I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant” [Genesis 9:16].


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 5:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/5:11)


וז"ש, **ואלמלא דנראו לא אשתארון בעלמא** כו': יש כאן סוד גדול. כי תחלה נבנית הנוקבה בסוד ב' המאורות הגדולים, שיש לה לנוקבא קומה שוה עם ז"א, אלא שעומדת באחוריו של ז"א, שבשביל זה קטרג הירח שאין ב' מלכים משתמשים בכתר אחד, וע"כ נבחנים אלו המוחין מוחין דאחור, וכן נקראים מוחין דו"ק דנוקבא, שהם מוחין שבשעת קטנותה, כלומר מתחילת התהוותה. ואז נבחנים הזו"ן לאפי זוטרי, ונק' ינוקי רביין עולמין. אלא אחר שהיא משתלמת עם המוחין הללו, חוזרת לעיבור ב' לאו"א עילאין, ואז נבנית בנין גדול, במוחין דפב"פ עם הז"א. ואז הם נק' אפי רברבי, ונודע, שאין שינוי או העדר ברוחני, ואלו המוחין דאחור, אפי זוטרי, נשארים בה גם בעת המוחין דגדלות. ולא עוד אלא שסבת המשכת המוחין דחיה הנ"ל הם בעיקר בכלים דמוחין דאחור בסוד אפי זוטרי. וז"ש, **ואלמלא דנראו לא אשתארון בעלמא** כלומר, דאלמלא דנראו בנוקבא אותם הנצנים כבר מזמן בעת קטנותה, דהיינו בבנין האחורים שלה כנ"ל, הנה לא אשתארון בה המוחין דחיה גם בעת גדלות, כי לא היו לה כלים במה לקבלם.


[Rabbi Shimon] continues: **“Had they not appeared, they would not have remained in the world** etc.”¹² There is a great secret here. For the *Nukba* was initially constructed in the mystical meaning of the two great lights,¹³ and *Nukba*. at which time the *Nukba* had an equal level to *Ze’er Anpin*. However, [*Nukba*] stands at the back of *Ze’er Anpin*, which is why the moon complained that two kings cannot use a single crown. Therefore, these brains [attained by *Ze'er Anpin* and *Nukba* in that state] are considered the brains of the back,¹⁴. and they are accordingly called the brains of the six extremities of *Nukba*, which are the brains of her immaturity, i.e., [the brains of] her initial formation. At that time, [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* are considered “small faces,” and they are called “children,” “youths,” and “youngsters.” However, once *Nukba* has been completed with these brains [of the back], she returns for a second gestation to the *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*, and then [the *Nukba*] is built as a major structure, with the brains of the face-to-face with *Ze’er Anpin*, and then they are called the “large faces.” It is known that there is no change or loss in the spiritual, and [thus] those [previously attained] brains of the back, the small face, remain in [*Nukba*] even at the time of the brains of maturity. Furthermore, the cause of the drawing down of the aforementioned brains of *ḥaya* lies primarily in the vessels of the brains of the back in the mystical meaning of the small face.¹⁵ And this is the meaning of: **“Had they not appeared already, they would not have remained in the world.”** That is, had those flowers [representing the brains of the back] not appeared in the *Nukba* already at the time of her immaturity, i.e., in the construction of her back, the brains of *ḥaya* would not have remained in [the *Nukba*] during the time of maturity either, since she would have had no vessels in which to receive them.

footnotes:
¹² As will be explained, each usage of "they" in this line refers to something different.

###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/6:1)


ו) **ומאן מקיים עלמא** וכו': ומי הוא המקיים את העולם וגורם לאבות שיתגלו. היינו קול הילדים העוסקים בתורה, ובשביל ילדי עולם אלו, העולם ניצל. כנגדם כתוב, תורי זהב נעשה לך. אלו הם ילדים, נערים, עלמים, שכתוב, ועשית שנים כרובים זהב.


**6. “And who sustains the world etc.”**
**And who** is that who **sustains the world and causes the Patriarchs to be revealed?** It is **the sound of children engaged in the Torah, and on account of these children of the world, the world is saved. Corresponding to them,** it is stated: **“We will make you circlets of gold”** [Song of Songs 1:11] **– these are children, lads, and youngsters, as it is stated: “And you shall make two cherubim of gold”** [Exodus 25:18].


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/6:2)


ביאור הדברים **רביין דעלמא** הם בחי' מוחין דאחור הנ"ל בדיבור הסמוך, הנקרא **אפי זוטרי**, וכן **רביין דעלמא** וכן **ינוקי רביין עולמין** ובחי' הזווג שלהם במצב זה, נקרא **קל ינוקי דלעאן באורייתא**. וה"ס **תורי זהב** וה"ס **ב' הכרובים**, דאינון אפי זוטרי, אשר אלו המוחין דחיה הנמשכים בסוד התכללות ימינא בשמאלא, לא היו מקובלים כלל בנוקבא זולתם, כמ"ש כל זה לעיל בדיבור הסמוך. וז"ש, **ומאן מקיים עלמא**, דהיינו בעת ריבוי הקלי' שיש להן כח להחריב עולם כבימי המבול, הנה אין תקנה זולת בהמשכת מוחין דחיה בסוד קשת בענן, כנ"ל, שעי"ז **עלמא אשתזיב** ומי הוא המקיים והמציל את העולם בעת ההיא, וגרם **לאבהן דאתגליין** שגורמים לגילוי החג"ת בסוד מוחין דראש, שהחג"ת נעשו אז לחב"ד דחיה. ואומר, שהגורם לכל זה הוא, **קל ינוקי דלעאן באורייתא**, דהיינו המוחין דאחור כנ"ל. שה"ס קל ינוקי ותורי זהב.


Explanation: The **“children of the world”** are the brains of the back that were mentioned just above, which are called the “small face.”¹. Likewise, the **“children of the world,”** as well as the **“children, lads, and youngsters”** [refers to the brains of the back]. The aspect of their fusion in this state is called **“the sound of children engaged in the Torah.”** This is the mystical meaning of the **“circlets of gold,”** and the mystical meaning of the **“two cherubim,”** which are the “small face,” without which these brains of *ḥaya*, which are drawn through the mystical meaning of the incorporation of right in left, would not be received in the *Nukba* whatsoever. All of this was explained just previously. This is why [Rabbi Shimon] states: **“Who is that who sustains the world,”** i.e., at the time of increase of the *kelippot*, which have the power to destroy the world as in the days of the flood. There is no remedy [for this destruction] except by drawing the brains of *ḥaya* in the mystical meaning of the rainbow in the cloud, as stated, since through this, **“the world is saved.”** And who is that who sustains and saves the world at that time, **“and causes the Patriarchs to be revealed,”** causing the manifestation of *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* in the mystical meaning of the brains of the head, when *Ḥesed*, *Gevura*, and *Tiferet* become *Ḥokhma*, *Bina*, and *Da'at* of *ḥaya*? [Rabbi Shimon] says that the cause of all this is **“the sound of children engaged in the Torah,”** that is, the brains of the back, which is the mystical meaning of the sound of the children and the circlets of gold.

footnotes:
¹ As explained above and throughout this section, the "brains" refer to different levels of supernal light manifesting within the vessels of the partzuf


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:1)


ז) **בראשית ר' אלעזר** וכו': בראשית. ר"א פתח, שאו מרום עיניכם וראו מי ברא אלה. **שאו מרום עיניכם**, שואל, לאיזה מקום. ומשיב, למקום שכל העינים תלויות אליו. ומי הוא. הוא פתח עינים, שהוא מלכות דראש א"א, ושם תדעו, שעתיקא הסתום הזה, שנוהגת בו שאלה, **ברא אלה**, ומי הוא. הוא הנקרא **מ"י**, שהוא ז"ת דבינה, אותו הנקרא מקצה השמים למעלה, שהכל עומד ברשותו, ובשביל שנוהגת בו שאלה, והוא בדרך סתום שאינו מגולה, נקרא **מ"י**. שהוא לשון שאלה. כי למעלה ממנו, אין שאלה נוהגת שם. וקצה השמים הזה, שנוהגת שם שאלה נקרא **מ"י**.


**7. “In the beginning. Rabbi Elazar etc.”**
**“In the beginning.” Rabbi Elazar began** [his discourse with the following exposition]: **“Lift up your eyes on high and see: who [*mi*] has created these”** [Isaiah 40:26]. **“Lift up your eyes on high” –** he asks: **To which place?** He answers: **To the place where all eyes turn. And what is that?** [It is] **the opening of the eyes**, which is *Malkhut* of the head of *Arikh Anpin***. There you will know that this hidden ancient one, to whom the question applies,**¹ **“has created these.” And who is** [the one who created these]**? He is the one called *Mi*** [“Who”?]**,** which is the seven lower [*sefirot*] of *Bina*, **that which is called, “from the edge of the heavens above,” and all lies in its demesnes. And since the** [concept of] **question refers to this** [aspect of the *sefirot* of *Bina*]**, and this is concealed, it is called *Mi***, the language of questioning**. For above this** [level]**, there are no questions. This edge of the heavens**, where the question is found, **is called *Mi*.**

footnotes:
¹ This "question" will be explained below.


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:2)


ביאור הדברים **ר' אלעזר פתח**. הוא בא לבאר הפירוש של בריאת שמים וארץ שבמקרא דבראשית. כי שמים וארץ הם הכלל דז' ימי בראשית, שהם הזו"ן דאצילות, ואם כן למה כתוב ברא שהיא בריאה ולא אצילות, והיה צ"ל האציל. ואומר, **ומאן איהו פתח עינים**, המלכות דראש א"א דאצילות מכונה פתח עינים, כי ספירת החכמה של ע"ס דראש נק' עינים. ונודע שאין בראש א"א אלא כתר חכמה בלבד, וע"כ המלכות שלו נק' פתח עינים, כי בפתיחתה מושפעים המוחין דחכמה מראש א"א, לכל פרצופי אצילות. וז"ש, **לאתר דכל עיינין תליאן ליה** כי מוחין דחכמה נק' עיינין, ואין מוחין דחכמה בכלהו פרצופי אצילות, זולת ע"י פתיחתה של המלכות דראש א"א.


Explanation: **“Rabbi Elazar began” –** his purpose is to clarify the interpretation of the creation of heaven and earth that appears in the Biblical account of *Bereshit*. For heaven and earth are the totality of the seven days of creation, which are the *Ze’er* [*Anpin*] and *Nukba* of *Atzilut*.² is the root of everything below it. The levels of *Ze'er Anpin* and *Nukba* (the *partzufim* of *Atzilut* that correspond to the six extremities and *Malkhut* respectively) of *Atzilut* represent the seven days of Creation. If so, why is it written “*bara* [“created”], which is *Beria* rather than *Atzilut*; it should have said *he’etzil* (emanated).³, it should not have used the word *bara*, which is a reference to the world of *Beria*, the lower world beneath *Atzilut*. He then says: **“And what is that? The opening of the eyes.”** The *Malkhut* of the head of *Arikh Anpin* of *Atzilut* is called **“the opening of the eyes,”** as the *sefira* of *Ḥokhma* from the ten *sefirot* of the head is called “eyes.” As is known, there are only *Keter* and *Ḥokhma* in the head of *Arikh Anpin*,⁴ of *Bina*, *Tiferet* and *Malkhut* are ejected from the head of *Arikh Anpin*. The implications of this ejection are elaborated upon in the next paragraphs. and therefore its *Malkhut* is called “the opening of the eyes,” since with its opening the brains of *Ḥokhma* flow from the head of *Arikh Anpin* to all the *partzufim* of *Atzilut*.⁵, resulting from the second constriction, effectively blocks and controls the flow of the light of *Ḥokhma* to the lower levels. This is why [Rabbi Elazar] states **“to the place where all eyes turn,”** as the brains of *Ḥokhma* are called “eyes,”⁶ of the different *partzufim* ("eyes") turn toward the "opening of the eyes," the *Ḥokhma* that is within the head of *Arikh Anpin*. and there are no brains of *Ḥokhma* in all of the *partzufim* of *Atzilut*, except by opening the *Malkhut* of the head of *Arikh Anpin*.

###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:3)


**ותמן תנדעון**, היינו בפתח עינים, שהוא המלכות דראש דא"א, שם תנדעון הסוד הזה, איך שהבינה בראה את הזו"ן. כי המלה ברא, פירושה לבר ממדרגת אצילות, ומתוך שהבינה עצמה יצאה לבר ממדרגת הראש דא"א, ונעשתה משום זה לבחינת בריאה בערך הראש דא"א, ע"כ היא בראה בהכרח גם את הזו"ן, ונעשה הז"א בבחינת יצירה, כי היוצא מבחינת בריאה נק' יצירה, והנוקבא נעשתה בחינת עשיה, כי כל היוצא מיצירה, נק' עשיה. אמנם אין להשוותם לבי"ע ממש שמאחורי הפרסא דאצילות, כי אלו הבינה וזו"ן עומדים למעלה מפרסא דהיינו בעולם אצילות, אלא הכוונה היא בערך הראש דא"א לבד, וע"כ יש ב' מיני בי"ע, הא' הוא בי"ע דפרודא, שנפרדו מכל בחינת אצילות ע"י הפרסא, שהוא הקרקע דעולם האצילות העומדת עליהם מלמעלה. והב' הם הבי"ע דעולם אצילות גופיה, שהם הבינה וז"א ונוקביה שהם לבר מהראש דא"א בלבד, ועדיין הם אצילות, אלא שהפרסא שבגוי מעוהי דא"א, שבמקום החזה שלו, עומדת עליהם מלמעלה, שמשום זה הם נבדלים מבחינת ראש דא"א, ונחשבים לבחינת גוף בלי ראש, כלומר למחוסרי מוחין דחכמה, הנק' ראש מבחי' עולם אצילות, כי בדרך כלל נבחן עולם האצילות לבחינת חכמה, דכללות ד' עולמות אבי"ע, וע"כ המחוסר חכמה, נבחן שם לגוף בלי ראש. ויתבאר עוד להלן.


**“There you will know” –** i.e., at the opening of the eyes, which is the *Malkhut* of the head of *Arikh Anpin*. There you will know this secret, how the *Bina* created the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*, as the word *bara* means *lebar* [“outside of”] the level of *Atzilut*. Since *Bina* herself emerged to outside of the level of the head of *Arikh Anpin*,⁷ from the head of *Arikh Anpin* took place as a result of the ascent of *Malkhut* in the second constriction. and thereby became considered *Beria*,⁸ was ejected from the head of *Arikh Anpin*, *Bina* is viewed here as a level of *Beria* (considered "outside") relative to *Arikh Anpin*. This is the case despite the fact that the *Bina* under discussion is the *Bina* of *Atzilut*, and in fact, this *Bina* is still in the level of *Atzilut*, as will be explained. in relation to the head of *Arikh Anpin*, it must be [the case] that she created the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* as well. The [*partzuf*] of *Ze’er Anpin* became *Yetzira*, because what emerges from *Beria* is called *Yetzira*, and the *Nukba* became *Asiya*, since whatever emerges from *Yetzira* is called *Asiya*. However, they must not be compared to the actual *Beria*, *Yetzira*, and *Asiya*, which are below the diaphragm of *Atzilut*, because these [*partzufim* of] *Bina* and [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* are positioned above the diaphragm in the world of *Atzilut*. Rather, it refers to [them as *Beria* relative] only to the head of *Arikh Anpin*. Therefore, there are two kinds of *Beria*, *Yetzira*, and *Asiya*: The first is a *Beria*, *Yetzira*, and *Asiya* of separation, which were separated from all of *Atzilut* through the diaphragm, which is the floor of the world of *Atzilut* that is positioned over [those lower worlds] from above. The second is *Beria*, *Yetzira*, and *Asiya* of the world of *Atzilut* itself, which are the *Bina*, *Ze’er Anpin*, and *Nukba*. These [*partzufim*] are only outside of the head of *Arikh Anpin*, and they are still *Atzilut*, except that the diaphragm inside the intestine of *Arikh Anpin*,⁹ are described in human terms as "limbs" and "organs." The diaphragm in the chest of *Arikh Anpin* will be explained more fully in the next sections. at the place of its chest, is positioned over them from above. For this reason, these [*partzufim*] are separated from the head of *Arikh Anpin* and are considered a body without a head. That is, the [lower *partzufim* of *Atzilut*] lack the brains of *Ḥokhma*, which is called a head, with respect to the world of *Atzilut*.¹⁰ are the lights of *Ḥokhma*. As these lower *partzufim* are cut off from this light, they lack access to the head of *Arikh Anpin*, and are only the composite level of a body without a head. This is because the world of *Atzilut* is usually considered *Ḥokhma* of all four worlds: *Atzilut*, *Beria*, *Yetzira*, and *Asiya*, and therefore that which lacks *Ḥokhma* there is regarded as a body without a head.

###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:4)


וז"ש, **דהאי סתים עתיקא** וכו' **ברא אלה**, הבינה שיצאה מהראש דא"א, מכח הנוקבא שעלתה לחכמה דא"א, וסיימה שם בחינת הראש דא"א, שמשום זה יצאה לבחינת בריאה וגוף דא"א, כנ"ל, הנה היא נחלקה משום זה לב' בחינות: ג"ר בפ"ע, וז"ת בפ"ע, מטעם, כי הבינה ממקורה בע"ס דאור ישר, אין מטבעה לקבל חכמה כלל, אלא רק אור חסדים בלבד, בסו"ה כי חפץ חסד הוא ולא חכמה, ((עי' בפתיחה לחכמת הקבלה אות ה') ולפיכך אין יציאתה לגוף פוגמתה כלל, שהרי אפילו בעת שהיא נמצאת בראש א"א, אינה מקבלת ממנו חכמה, ולפיכך אין לה שום פחיתות של משהו מחמת עמידתה למטה ממלכות דראש דא"א, ונחשבת גם עתה לבחינת ראש גמור, וכאלו לא יצאה כלל מהראש דא"א דמיא. והיא נתקנת בסוד או"א עילאין המלבישין לא"א מפה עד החזה. ובחינה הב' שהיא הז"ת דבינה, הנה הן מבחינת התכללות הזו"ן בבינה, שהם שרשים של הזו"ן הנמצאים בבינה, ולפיכך הם צריכים להארת חכמה בשביל הזו"ן, וע"כ הם נפגמו מחמת מציאותם בגוף דא"א, שנעשו למחוסרי חכמה, והם נחשבים לבריאה, ולו"ק בלי ראש. ועליהם נאמר אבא הוציא אמא לחוץ, דהיינו לבר מהראש דא"א, והם נק' ישסו"ת, ומלבישין לא"א מחזה עד הטבור, והבנים שלהם שהם הזו"ן, הם מלבישים מטבור ולמטה, דא"א עד סיום עולם האצילות. וז"ס הפרסא שבגוי מעוהי דא"א העומדת בחזה שלו, כי היא כח המלכות שבראש דא"א המוציא את הז"ת דבינה לבר מראש, ומפריעתם מלקבל חכמה, כי אע"פ שמסך הזה עומד בפה דראש א"א, מ"מ שם אינו פועל כלום, כי שם עומדים או"א עילאין, שהם בחי' הג"ר דבינה, הנחשבים עוד לבחי' ראש א"א מטעם הנ"ל, ונמצא כי רק במקום החזה דהיינו ממעל הז"ת דבינה שולט כח המסך להוציא הז"ת דבינה שמתחתיו לבר מראש דא"א, וזכור זה.


The meaning of **“that this hidden ancient one** etc. **has created these”** is as follows: The *Bina* that emerged from the head of *Arikh Anpin* from the force of the *Nukba* that ascended¹¹ to *Ḥokhma* of *Arikh Anpin*, where [the *Nukba*] formed an endpoint of the head of *Arikh Anpin* – as this is why [*Bina*] emerged to *Beria* and the body of *Arikh Anpin*, as stated – [this *Bina*] is therefore divided into two aspects: The first three [*sefirot*] on their own, and the lower seven [*sefirot*] on their own.¹² or structure is formed of all ten *sefirot*. Thus, this level of *Bina* is made of ten *sefirot*, and as a result of the ejection of *Bina* from the head, there is a structural distinction between the first three *sefirot* of *Bina* and the lower seven. The reason is that it is not in the nature of the *Bina*, in her source of the ten *sefirot* of the direct light,¹³ in the myriad structures of existence is always a reflection of its primary root *sefira* in the structure of direct light, the light flowing from the Creator to creation through a set of ten *sefirot*. The level of *Bina* in the direct light structure only draws the light of giving, not the light of *Ḥokhma*. to receive *Ḥokhma* at all, but only the light of giving, in the mystical meaning of the verse “because He delights in *Ḥesed*” [“mercy”; Micah 7:18] – and not [the light of] *Ḥokhma* (see *Petiḥa leḤokhmat HaKabbala*, section 5). Therefore, the emergence [of *Bina*] to the body does not impair [*Bina*] at all, since even when [*Bina*] is in the head of *Arikh Anpin*, [*Bina*] does not receive [the light of] *Ḥokhma* from there. Thus, [*Bina*] is not lessened at all on account of her position below the *Malkhut* of the head of *Arikh Anpin*, and now too [*Bina*] is fully considered a head, and it is as though she never emerged from the head of *Arikh Anpin*.¹⁴ of *Bina* only draw the light of giving, there is no change in the situation of *Bina* when it is ejected from the head of *Arikh Anpin* to an environment lacking access to the light of *Ḥokhma*. The first three *sefirot* of *Bina* are established in the mystical meaning of *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*, who enclothe *Arikh Anpin* from the mouth to the chest. The second aspect [of *Bina*], which is the lower seven [*sefirot*] of *Bina*, are from the incorporation of [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* in *Bina*, which are the roots of [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* that are in *Bina*.¹⁵ of any structure consist of six extremities (*Ze'er Anpin*) and *Malkhut* (*Nukba*). Thus, the lower seven of *Bina* mentioned here serve as roots for the lower level *partzufim* of *Atzilut* called *Ze'er Anpin* and *Nukba*. These [lower seven *sefirot*] therefore require the illumination of [the light of] *Ḥokhma* for the [lower *partzufim* of *Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*, and consequently these [lower seven *sefirot* of *Bina*] were impaired by their positioning in the body of *Arikh Anpin*, for they became devoid of [the light of] *Ḥokhma*, and these [lower seven] are considered *Beria* and six extremities without a head.¹⁶ from the head of *Arikh Anpin* did not impair the first three of *Bina*, which do not need the light of *Ḥokhma*, the lower seven were impaired, since they require the light of *Ḥokhma*. It is with regard to them that it is stated that "the father removed the mother outside,"¹⁷ and the "mother" is *Bina*. i.e., outside of the head of *Arikh Anpin*. These [lower seven] are called *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, and they enclothe *Arikh Anpin* from the chest to the navel, while their sons, [the *partzufim* of *Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*, enclothe from the navel and below, of *Arikh Anpin*, until the end of the world of *Atzilut*. This is the mystical meaning of the diaphragm that is inside the intestine of *Arikh Anpin*, which is positioned at his chest. For [this diaphragm] is the force of the *Malkhut* of the head of *Arikh Anpin*, which ejects the lower seven [*sefirot*] of *Bina* outside of the head and disrupts them from receiving [the light of] *Ḥokhma*. For although this partition is positioned at the mouth of the head of *Arikh Anpin*, nevertheless it does not effect [change] there in any way, since the *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in* are positioned there [below the mouth], and they are the first three [*sefirot*] of *Bina*, which are still considered the head of *Arikh Anpin*, for the reason stated above. Accordingly, it is only at the place of the chest, i.e., above the lower seven of *Bina*, that the power of the partition has impact, removing the lower seven of *Bina* that are underneath it, to outside of the head of *Arikh Anpin*. Remember this.

###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:5)


ולפיכך הג"ר דבינה, נק' בשם האי סתים עתיקה, כי הראש דא"א נק' עתיקא קדישא, וכיון שהג"ר דבינה אע"פ שהם מפה ולמטה דא"א נבחנים כאלו עומדים עוד בראש דא"א, ע"כ נקראים גם הם בשם עתיקא כמו הראש דא"א, אלא משום המצאם בגוף א"א נק' בשם סתים עתיקא.


Therefore, the first three [*sefirot*] of *Bina* are called **“this hidden ancient one,”** as the head of *Arikh Anpin* is called “the holy ancient one.” Since the first three [*sefirot*] of *Bina* are considered as though they are still positioned at the head of *Arikh Anpin*,¹⁸ of *Bina* are unchanged by their ejection from the head of *Arikh Anpin*, it is as though they are still positioned within that head and are thus referred to as "this hidden ancient one." despite being [positioned] below the mouth of *Arikh Anpin*, these [first three *sefirot*] are therefore also called ancient, like the head of *Arikh Anpin*. However, on account of their position in the body of *Arikh Anpin*, they are called “hidden ancient one.”

###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 7:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:6)


וזה אמרו **דהאי סתים עתיקא דקיימא לשאלה ברא אלה** כלומר, רק הז"ת של האי סתים עתיקא הנק' ישסו"ת שהם בחי' **קיימא לשאלה**, דהיינו לקבל בתוכם את הזו"ן ע"י עלית מ"ן, כי שאלה פירושו עלית מ"ן מלשון שואלין על הגשמים. (ריש תענית) ואומר שרק הז"ת דהאי סתים עתיקא הנק' ישסו"ת שהן קיימות לשאלה, דהיינו לקבל מ"ן להמשכת אור החכמה, להיותן מחוסרי חכמה, שלפני זה הן נחשבות לבחינת בריאה, וע"כ **ברא אלה**, שהם הזו"ן הנק' אלה. ונבראו גם הם בכחם במחוסרי ראש כמהו. כי המלה ברא מורה על חסרון ראש מבחי' אצילות. וז"ש **ומאן איהו מ"י**: הז"ת דבינה שהן עומדות לשאלה, הן הנק' מ"י,ועליהן נופלת לשון ברא, כנ"ל, כי הן עצמן נעשו בחינת בריאה, מחמת הפרסא שבחזה דא"א המבדלת אותן מהארת ראש דא"א. כנ"ל. וז"ש **מקצה השמים לעילא דכלא קיימא ברשותיה**, הז"ת דבינה, שהן נק' ישסו"ת ונק' מ"י הן בחי' **קצה השמים לעילא**, כי השמים הם ז"א, והוא מקבל רק מישסו"ת הנק' **מ"י**, וע"כ נק' המ"י **קצה השמים לעילא, דכלא קיימא ברשותיה**, כי השמים והארץ שהם זו"ן וכן הג' עלמין בי"ע התחתונים כולם מקבלים מישסו"ת הזה הנקרא מ"י, וע"כ כלא קיימא ברשותיה.


This is why [Rabbi Elazar] states **“that this hidden ancient one, to whom the question applies, has created these,”** i.e., only the lower seven [*sefirot*] of this hidden ancient one, which are called *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, **“to whom the question applies,”** that is, to receive the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* within them¹⁹ from a higher level. This yearning ascends to the level above and is described as a manifestation of that lower level within the higher level. This yearning is the meaning of the "question" mentioned here, a request of *Ze'er Anpin* and *Nukba* for the light of *Ḥokhma*. *Yisrael Saba* and *Tevuna*, the lower seven *sefirot* of *Bina* receive this yearning manifestation from below and escalate the process further to ultimately release the light of *Ḥokhma* to the lower levels. by raising the feminine waters. This is because the “question” refers to the ascent of the feminine waters, as in the phrase “we ask for rain” [*Ta’anit* 1:1]. He is saying that only the lower seven [*sefirot*] of this hidden ancient one, which are called *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, are ready for the question, i.e., to receive the feminine waters in order to draw forth the light of *Ḥokhma*, since [these lower seven *sefirot* of *Bina*] are devoid of [the light of] *Ḥokhma*. Before that [these lower seven *sefirot*] are considered *Beria*,²⁰ are truly called a level of *Beria*, since the first three remain unchanged from their previous state despite being ejected from the head. and therefore [*Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*] **“created these,”** which are the [*Ze’er Anpin* and *Nukba*, known as “these.” [*Ze’er Anpin* and *Nukba*] were also created, in their strengths, devoid of a head, like [*Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*]. For the word *bara* indicates the lack of a head with respect to *Atzilut*. This is why [Rabbi Elazar] states: **“And who is this? It is the one called *Mi*** [Who]**.** The lower seven [*sefirot*] of *Bina*, which are ready for a question [of feminine waters], are called *Mi*, and the word *bara* refers to them, as stated, since they themselves became *Beria*, on account of the diaphragm of the chest of *Arikh Anpin*, which separates [the lower seven *sefirot* of *Bina*] from the illumination of the head of *Arikh Anpin*, as stated. This is why [Rabbi Elazar] says: **“From the edge of the heavens above, and who is in possession of everything.”** The lower seven of *Bina*, which are called *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, and are called *Mi*, are considered **“from the edge of the heavens above,”** since the heavens are *Ze’er Anpin*, and he receives only from *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, which is called ***Mi***. Therefore, *Mi* is called **“from the edge of the heavens above, and all lies in its demesnes,”** as the heaven and earth, which are [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*, and similarly the lower three worlds of *Beria*, *Yetzira*, and *Asiya*, all receive from this *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, which is called *Mi*. Consequently, “all lies in its demesnes.”

¹⁹ The concept of feminine waters is meant as an analogy for the dynamic of "yearning from below," in which a lower level yearns to receive the light of Ḥokhma
²⁰ As has been explained, only the lower seven of Bina


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 7:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/7:7)


וז"ש, **לעילא לית תמן שאלה והאי קצה השמים אקרי מ"י**: כלומר, לעילא דהיינו הג"ר דבינה, שהן או"א עלאין, **לית תמן שאלה**, כי הם אינם מקבלים מ"ן להמשכת חכמה, להיותם בעצם רק בחינת אור חסדים ואינם מחוסרי חכמה, וע"כ אינם נק' מ"י, גם אינם בחי' **קצה השמים**, כי הם אינם נזקקים לזו"ן הצריכים להארת החכמה. ורק הז"ת שהן ישסו"ת שהם קיימין לשאלה, דהיינו לקבל מ"ן מהזו"ן ולעלות לראש דא"א לקבל בשבילם הארת חכמה, ע"כ נבחנים לקצה השמים לעילא, משום שהז"א הנק' שמים מקבל מהם.


This is why [Rabbi Elazar] says: **“Above this there are no questions, and this edge of the heavens is called *Mi*.”** In other words, above, i.e., the first three [*sefirot*] of *Bina*, which are the [*partzuf*] of *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*, **“there are no questions,”** as these [first three] do not receive the feminine waters for drawing forth [the light of] *Ḥokhma*, since the [first three] are only the light of giving and they do not lack *Ḥokhma*,²¹. and therefore they are not called *Mi*. The [first three] are also not considered the **“edge of the heavens,”** because they are not at the behest of the request of [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* [through feminine waters] for the illumination of [the light of] *Ḥokhma*. It is only the lower seven [*sefirot*], which are *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, which are established to [receive] the question – i.e., to receive the feminine waters from the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*, and to ascend to the head of *Arikh Anpin* to receive the illumination of *Ḥokhma* on their behalf – that are therefore regarded as “the edge of the heavens above,” because the *Ze’er Anpin*, which is called “heaven,” receives from them.

²¹ Since the first three are of the light of giving, they do not lack or yearn for the light of Ḥokhma


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:1)


ח) **ואית אחרא לתתא** וכו': ויש אחר למטה, ונקרא **מ"ה**. מה בין זה לזה. ומשיב, אלא הראשון הסתום, שנקרא **מ"י**, נוהגת בו שאלה, כיון ששאל האדם וחקר להסתכל ולדעת ממדרגה למדרגה עד סוף כל המדרגות, שהוא מלכות, אחר שהגיע שמה, הוא **מ"ה**. שפירושו, מה ידעת, מה הסתכלת, מה חקרת, הלא הכל סתום כבתחילה. **מפשפש** פירושו חקר. כי חקר, מתרגם פשפש (איוב ח' ח').


**8. “And there is another one, below etc.”**
**And there is another one, below, which is called *Ma*** [“What?”]**. What is the difference between this one and that one?** He answers: **[Regarding] the first, hidden one, called *Mi*, a question applies to it. [Regarding the second], since the person questioned and investigated, to examine and know from one level to another until the end of all levels,** which is *Malkhut*, **once he has arrived there,** that is ***Ma*,** meaning: **“What did you know?” “What did you observe?” “What did you investigate?” Yet, everything is as concealed as before.** *Mefashpesh* means “investigate,” as *ḥeker* [“searched out”; Job 8:8] is translated into Aramaic as *pishpesh*.


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:2)


ביאור הדברים, הנוקבא דז"א, בהיותה עם הז"א פב"פ, נקראת גם הנוקבא בשם **מ"ה**, כמו הז"א, והיא נבחנת לבחינת קצה שמים דלתתא, כי היא סוף כל דרגין ומסיימת את האצילות, ונמצא הז"א הנק' שמים עומד בין הישסו"ת הנק' קצה השמים לעילא, ובין הנוק' הנק' קצה השמים לתתא. וז"ש **כיון דשאל בר נש ומפשפש לאסתכלא: לאסתכלא** היינו הזווג דאו"א הנק' הסתכלות או"א זה בזה ע"י עליתם לראש דא"א, שאז הבינה חוזרת לקבל הארת החכמה בשביל הזו"ן, כי אפילו ישסו"ת שהם הז"ת דבינה אינם צריכים להארת החכמה לצורך עצמם, כי מבחינת עצמם דומים הז"ת דבינה אל הג"ר שלהם, ואינם נזקקים לקבל חכמה. אלא בעת שהזו"ן עולים למ"ן לישסו"ת, מתעוררים הישסו"ת בשבילם לעלות לראש דא"א ולקבל חכמה. אבל גם הזו"ן אינם עולים למ"ן לישסו"ת רק ע"י העלאת מ"ן מבני אדם התחתונים אל הזו"ן. באופן שנשמות בני אדם עולות למ"ן אל הזו"ן, ואז עולים הזו"ן למ"ן אל הישסו"ת, ואז עולים הישסו"ת לא"א ונעשים שם פרצוף אחד עם או"א עילאין, ואז מסתכלים או"א זה בזה וממשיכים חכמה בשביל הזו"ן.


Explanation: The *Nukba* of *Ze’er Anpin*, when it is with *Ze’er Anpin* [in a state of] face-to-face, is also called ***Ma***, just like *Ze’er Anpin*. [The *Nukba*] is [also] considered “the lower edge of the heavens,” since it is the end of all the levels and is the endpoint of *Atzilut*. It follows that *Ze’er Anpin*, which is called “heavens,” is positioned between the [the *partzuf* of] *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, which is called “the upper edge of the heavens,” and the *Nukba*, which is called “the lower edge of the heavens.” [Rabbi Elazar] thus states: **“Since man questioned and investigates, to observe.” “To observe [*le-istakala*]”** is referring to the coupling of *Abba* and *Imma*,¹ structure of the first three *sefirot* of *Bina* discussed in the previous sections. As will be explained, when the *Abba* and *Imma* (literally: father and mother) ascend to the head of *Arikh Anpin*, they serve as a bridge for the light of *Ḥokhma* to reach the lower levels. This is accomplished through the *Abba* and *Imma* components "facing each other" and fusing. This is a sexual imagery, with the transmission of the light to lower levels serving as a "reproductive" expression of this fusion. which is called the gazing [*histaklut*] of *Abba* and *Imma* at each other as a result of their ascent to the head of *Arikh Anpin*. At that stage, the *Bina* returns to receive the illumination of *Ḥokhma* for the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*. The reason is that even *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, which are the seven lower [*sefirot*] of *Bina*, do not need the illumination of *Ḥokhma* for themselves, since with respect to themselves the seven lower ones of *Bina* are similar to the first three [*sefirot* of *Bina*] and [thus] do not need to receive [the light of] *Ḥokhma*.² is of the light of giving, even the lower seven *sefirot* of *Bina* do not need the light of *Ḥokhma* for themselves. They only need to transmit it through to *Ze'er Anpin* below. Nevertheless, when the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* ascend as feminine waters to *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* awaken for [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*] to ascend to the head of *Arikh Anpin* and receive [the light of] *Ḥokhma*. However, even the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* do not ascend as feminine waters to *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, except through the ascent of feminine waters from the people of the lower levels to the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*. The process is that the souls of people ascend as feminine waters to the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*, and then the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* ascend as feminine waters to *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, and *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* ascend to *Arikh Anpin* and become one *partzuf* with *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*. At that stage, *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in* gaze at each other and draw forth [the light of] *Ḥokhma* for the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*.

###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:3)


וזה אמרו **כיון דשאל בר נש** דהיינו שמעלה מ"ן, **ומפשפש** היינו שמפשפש במעשיו. כדי להעלות הזו"ן לזווג או"א, דהיינו **לאסתכלא** בכדי שאו"א יסתכלו זה בזה וימשיכו חכמה. **ולמנדע מדרגא לדרגא עד סוף כל דרגין**, כי הארת החכמה הנמשכת ע"י עלית מ"ן וזווג כנ"ל, נק' בשם ידיעה, או נק' חכמה ע"י הדעת, כי הזו"ן העולים למ"ן נבחנים שם לבחי' דעת לאו"א, כי המה הגורמים לזווג שלהם, והזווג נק' בשם ידיעה, מלשון, וידע אדם את חוה אשתו. וז"ש **ולמנדע** דהיינו להמשיך המוחין בסוד הדעת **מדרגא לדרגא** מדעת של מדרגת או"א אל המוחין דמדרגת הז"א, **עד סוף כל דרגין** דהיינו מהז"א אל הנוקבא הנק' סוף כל דרגין. וענין עלית מ"ן )עי' בפתיחה לחכמת הקבלה אות צ"ד וצ"ה(. כי הבינה עומדת אב"א עם החכמה להיותה רק בחי' חסדים, וחוזרת פב"פ עם החכמה רק לצורך הזו"ן. ע"ש.


Accordingly, [Rabbi Elazar] states: **“Since man questioned,”** meaning [man] raised feminine waters, **“and investigates,”** that is, [man] investigates his actions in order to raise the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* for the coupling of [*Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*], i.e., **“to examine [*le-istakala*],”** in order that *Abba* and *Imma* will gaze [*yistaklu*] at each other and draw forth [the light of] *Ḥokhma*. **“And to know from one level to another until the end of all levels.”** For the illumination of *Ḥokhma* that is drawn forth through the ascent of feminine waters and fusion, as stated, is called “knowledge [*yedi’a*]” or “*Ḥokhma* by means of *Da'at* as the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* that ascend as feminine waters are there considered *Da'at* for *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*, as [*Ze’er Anpin* and *Nukba*] cause their coupling. [This] fusion is called “knowledge,” as in the phrase: “And the man knew Eve his wife” [Genesis 4:1]. [Rabbi Elazar] states: **“And to know,**” i.e., to draw forth the brains [of *Ḥokhma*] in the mystical meaning of the *Da'at*, **“from one level to another,”** from *Da'at* of the level of [*Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*] to the brains of the level of *Ze’er Anpin*. **“Until the end of all levels**” – from *Ze’er Anpin* to the *Nukba*, which is called “the end of all levels.” The meaning of the ascent of feminine waters (see *Petiḥa leḤokhmat HaKabbala*, sections 94 and 85) is that *Bina* is positioned back-to-back with *Ḥokhma*, as [*Bina*] is only the aspect of [the light of giving], and only turns to be face-to-face with *Ḥokhma* for the sake of [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba*; see there.³ and *Imma Ila'in* are the first three *sefirot* of *Bina* and *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* are the lower seven. This entire process revolves around the ascent of feminine waters triggering an ascent of the different aspects of *Bina* into a format in which they serve as a conduit for the light of *Ḥokhma* to flow from the head of *Arikh Anpin* to *Ze'er Anpin* and *Nukba*.

³ As explained throughout this section, Abba


###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:4)


וז"ש **כיון דמטי תמן מ"ה**: כיון שהמוחין מטי תמן אל הנוקבא דז"א, אז נקראת הנוקבא בשם מ"ה. ונק' כן מטעם המבואר בזוהר (תרומה דף קכ"ז ע"א). וז"ל, "**דרגא תתאה דאיהו רזא דעלמא תתאה אקרי מ"ה, ותנינן: אל תקרי מ"ה אלא מאה**,(מנחות מג:) **בגין דכל דרגין עילאין באשלמותהון הכא אינון**" עכ"ל. הרי שע"כ נק' מ"ה להורות שכל השלימות הגדולה של המוחין ההם באה רק אחר דמטי המוחין לנוקבא. ואומרו, **מה ידעת מה אסתכלתא מה פשפשתא הא כלא סתים כדקדמיתא**: גם זה מבואר בזוהר תרומה הנ"ל, וז"ל **תו, אמאי אקרי מ"ה, אלא אע"ג דמשיכו עילאה דאתמשך לא אתגליא עד דאשתלים הכא, דאיהו אתר סופא דכל דרגין, סופא דאמשכותא דכולא, וקיימא באתגליא, ואע"ג דאתגליא יתיר מכולא קיימא לשאלה, מ"ה, מה חמית, מה ידעת, כמא דאת אמרת, כי לא ראיתם כל תמונה** עכ"ל.


[Rabbi Elazar] says: **“Once it has arrived there, it is *Ma*.”** Once the brains arrive there, to the *Nukba* of *Ze’er Anpin*, the *Nukba* is called *Ma*. She is called by this [name] for the reason explained in the *Zohar* (*Teruma* 127a): “**The lower level, which is the mystical meaning of the lower world, is called *Ma*, and we learned: Do not read *ma* but *me’a*,**⁴ 43b]: A person is obligated to recite one hundred blessings every day, as it is stated: “And now, Israel, what [*ma*] does the Lord your God require of you” (Deuteronomy 10:12). **since all the upper levels are in their wholeness here.”** Thus, [*Nukba*] is necessarily called *Ma*, to indicate that the total wholeness of those brains comes only after the brains have arrived at the *Nukba*. He adds: **“What did you know; what did you observe; what did you investigate? After all, everything is as concealed as before.”** This is also explained in that passage of the *Zohar* in *Teruma*: **“Furthermore, why is she called *Ma*? Even though the drawing down of the supernal [light] that was drawn is not revealed until it is completed here, as this is the place of the end of all the levels, the destination of all the drawn down [supernal light], where it stands revealed. [Yet] although it is more revealed [there] than [in] any [of the other levels], it is ready for the question [of] ‘*Ma*?’ ‘What did you see?’ ‘What did you know?’ as it is said: ‘For you saw no manner of form’** [Deuteronomy 4:15]**”**

###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:5)


והנך רואה דברי הזוהר, שאע"פ שכבר נמשכו לה המוחין העליונים ע"י העלאת מ"ן וכבר נשלמה בהן, מ"מ איהי קיימא לשאלה כמו שישסו"ת היו מטרם העלאת מ"ן. וזהו ג"כ דברי ר' אלעזר כאן **מה ידעת מה אסתכלתא מה פשפשתא הא כלא סתים כדקדמיתא**, דהיינו ג"כ כמו בזוהר תרומה, אשר אחר העלאת המ"ן והמשכת המוחין עוד הכל סתום בנוקבא כמו מטרם העלאת מ"ן, דהיינו דקיימא עוד לשאלה, שפירושו העלאת מ"ן. )(כנ"ל אות ז' בד"ה וז"ש לעילא. לית תמן שאלה(.


You can see from the words of the *Zohar* that although the higher brains have already been drawn to [*Nukba*] through the ascent of feminine waters, and [the *Nukba*] was already completed through [those brains], nevertheless, [*Nukba*] is still poised for a question, just like *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* were before the ascent of feminine waters. This is also the meaning of Rabbi Elazar’s statement here: **What did you know; what did you observe; what did you investigate? After all, everything is as concealed as before,”** i.e., similar to the words of the *Zohar* in *Teruma*, that after the ascent of feminine waters and the drawing forth of the brains, everything remains concealed within the *Nukba*, as it was before the ascent of feminine waters. That is, [the *Nukba*] is still ready for a question, meaning the ascent of the feminine waters (as stated in the last paragraph of section 7, above).⁵ received the brains of the light of *Ḥokhma*, as a result of the ascent of feminine waters (the yearning "question" from below), that light is now concealed within the *Nukba*, and can only be accessed with a further ascent of feminine waters.

###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 8:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:6)


ויש להבין הדברים, א"כ מה מועילים התחתונים בהעלאת מ"ן, וכן למה נמשכו אליה המוחין כיון שאינם נגלים כלל. ועוד, שהרי אומרים שם בזוהר תרומה בטעם הא' למה נקראת הנוקבא מ"ה, משום שה"ס, אל תקרי מ"ה אלא מאה (מנחות מג:), שה"ס מאה ברכות, שהנוקבא משפעת לתחתונים. ולפי"ז איך יתכן לומר שעוד נשארת הנוקבא בבחינת קיימא לשאלה, והכל סתים כדקדמיתא.


These ideas require explanation: If [this is the case, that the light remains concealed in *Nukba*], what is the utility of the lower [beings] raising feminine waters, and why were the brains drawn to [*Nukba*], if they are not revealed at all? Furthermore, it is stated there in the *Zohar* in *Teruma*, with regard to the first reason as to why the *Nukba* is called *Ma*, that it is the mystical meaning of “do not read *ma* but *me’a*”⁶, meaning "one hundred." [*Menaḥot* 43b], which is the mystical meaning of one hundred blessings that the *Nukba* gives to the lower [levels]. Accordingly, how can it be said that the *Nukba* is still poised for a question, and everything is concealed as it was before?

###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 8:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:7)


והענין הוא: כי יש ב' בחינות מוחין דגדלות בנוקבא, הנק' גדלות א' וגדלות ב'. אשר בגדלות א', עולים רק או"א עילאין לראש דא"א ולא הישסו"ת, ואע"פ שנעשו לפרצוף אחד, מ"מ נשארו הישסו"ת בגוף א"א, אלא שנתעלו למקום או"א שמקודם לכן, דהיינו שמלבישין מפה עד החזה דא"א ולפיכך מצד אחד נעשו הישסו"ת בחי' ראש א"א, שהרי נעשו פרצוף אחד עם או"א עילאין העומדים עתה בראש א"א, וכן עלו למעלה מפרסא דחזה דא"א ששם מאיר הראש דא"א, ע"ד שנתבאר (עי' לעיל אות ז' ד"ה וז"ש דהאי סתים)( באו"א גופייהו שהיו עומדים שם מטרם העלאת מ"ן. ומשום זה הם משפיעים מוחין שלמים דג"ר אל הז"א, והז"א אל הנוקבא, והנוקבא נעשית בסוד מאה ברכות כנ"ל, כי ע"י מוחין אלו מתעלים הזו"ן ועולים למקום הישסו"ת שמקודם העלאת מ"ן, דהיינו מחזה עד הטבור דא"א, ונמצאת הנוק' במקום אמא, וע"כ נעשית הנוקבא בסוד מאה כמו אמא, כי בחי' מאה היא באמא ואלפים היא באבא, והתחתון העולה לעליון נעשה כמוהו, כנודע.


The meaning is that there are two aspects of the brains of maturity in the *Nukba*, which are called “the first maturity” and “the second maturity.” In the first maturity, only *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in* ascend to the head of *Arikh Anpin*, not *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*. Although they become one *partzuf*,⁷ and *Imma Ila'in* ascends back to the head of *Arikh Anpin*, *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* ascends to the area above the chest and below the mouth of *Arikh Anpin*, the position previously occupied by *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*. Since *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* are now above the diaphragm that previously separated between *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* and *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in**,* these two aspects of *Bina* are now considered one total *partzuf* again. *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* still remained in the body of *Arikh Anpin*, only [*Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*] ascended to the previous position of [*Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*], i.e., it enclothes from the mouth to the chest of *Arikh Anpin*. Therefore, on the one hand, *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* became the aspect of the head of *Arikh Anpin*, since it became one *partzuf* with *Abba* and *Imma Ila'in* that are now positioned at the head of *Arikh Anpin*, and likewise [*Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*] ascended above the diaphragm of the chest of *Arikh Anpin*, where the head of *Arikh Anpin* illuminates, in the manner that was explained earlier⁸ does not require the light of *Ḥokhma*, only the light of giving, the ejection of *Bina* below the mouth of *Arikh Anpin* does not change *Bina*’s connection with the head of *Arikh Anpin*. Only *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* positioned below the diaphragm, was affected, as was explained in the quoted section above. Now that *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* has ascended to the area above the chest (the diaphragm) and below the mouth, it="" is="" considered="" part="" of="" the="" head="" of="" i=""Arikh Anpin again, despite still being below the mouth. (see above, third paragraph of section 7) with regard to [*Abba* and *Imma Ila'in*] themselves, who were positioned there even before the ascent of the feminine waters. As a result, [*Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*] transmit completed brains of the first three [*sefirot* of *Ze'er Anpin*] to the *Ze’er Anpin*, and the *Ze’er Anpin* to the *Nukba*, and the *Nukba* becomes the mystical meaning of one hundred blessings, as stated. For by means of these brains, the [*Ze’er Anpin*] and *Nukba* are elevated and ascend to the position *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* was in before the ascent of the feminine waters, i.e., from the chest to the navel of *Arikh Anpin*. The *Nukba* is thus in the place of the *Imma* ("mother"),⁹, all levels of *partzufim* operate as pairs, in which there is a "male" and "female" aspect. While the term *Abba* and *Imma* generally refers to the *partzuf* of the first three *sefirot* of *Bina* (made up of male and female *partzufim*), these terms can also be applied to all the roles within the paired *partzufim* structures that exist below the second constriction. Thus, in the new structure discussed here, formed after the ascents of the various *partzufim*, *Nukba* serves as the female *partzuf* aspect of the level below the chest, previously occupied by the paired male-female *partzuf* structure of *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* (a similarly male and female pair of *partzufim*). As a result of this positioning, *Nukba* is called "*Imma,*" as *Nukba* takes the place of the female aspect of the *partzuf* structure of the level. and therefore the *Nukba* becomes the mystical meaning of "one hundred," like the *Imma*, because the aspect of "one hundred" is in the *Imma*, while [the aspect of] "thousands" is in the *Abba* ("father"), and the lower [entity] that ascends to the upper entity] becomes like it, as is known.¹⁰

###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 8:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:8)


אמנם מצד אחר, דומה הנוקבא רק לבחינת מ"י דקיימא לשאלה, דהיינו ממש לגמרי כמו שהישסו"ת היו מטרם העלאת המ"ן והמשכת המוחין. והוא מטעם הלבשתה את מקום הישסו"ת דקטנות, דהיינו מהחזה עד הטבור דא"א ונמצאת עומדת למטה מפרסא שבגוי מעוהי דא"א, שבחינת הארת ראש דא"א נפסק למעלה מפרסא זו, כנ"ל(אות ז' ד"ה וז"ש דהאי עש"ה).( וע"כ מבחינה זו לא הרויחה הנוקבא את המוחין וראש א"א, שכל העלאת המ"ן היו לזה, והכל סתים כדקדמיתא כמטרם העלאת מ"ן. אמנם מבחינה אחרת, הרי הרויחה הנוקבא בחינת אמא, כי עלתה למקום ישסו"ת, שנק' אמא, שז"ס שנעשתה בסוד מאה ברכות כנ"ל.


However, on the other hand, the *Nukba* is only similar to *Mi*,¹¹ has only reached the status of *Mi* and no further, as will be explained. which is poised for a question, i.e., precisely as *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* was before the ascent of feminine waters and the drawing forth of the brains. This is due to [*Nukba*] enclothing the place [where] *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* [was during the period] of immaturity, i.e., from the chest to the navel of *Arikh Anpin*. [The *Nukba*] is thus positioned below the diaphragm that is within the intestine of *Arikh Anpin*, and the illumination of the head of *Arikh Anpin* stops above this diaphragm, as stated above (third paragraph of section 7; see there carefully). Consequently, from this position the *Nukba* did not attain the brains and head of *Arikh Anpin*, for which all the ascents of feminine waters occurred, and everything is as concealed as before, as it was prior to the ascent of feminine waters.¹² access to the brains and head of *Arikh Anpin*, was not achieved. However, from a different perspective, the *Nukba* gained the aspect of the *Imma* (mother), as [the *Nukba*] ascended to the place of *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*, which is called *Imma*, and this is the mystical meaning of one hundred blessings, as stated above.

###### Sulam on Zohar, Introduction 8:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Sulam%20on%20Zohar/s/Introduction/r/8:9)


ומשום זה נבחנים אלו המוחין רק לבחינת ו"ק דגדלות, כי לא תוכל לקבל בחינת ראש דגדלות, להיותה נמצאת למטה מפרסא דחזה דא"א, כנ"ל, אבל מדרגתה עתה שוה כמו הישסו"ת בעת היותו בחינת ו"ק, דהיינו מטרם העלאת מ"ן, שהיה עומד שם מחזה עד הטבור דא"א. שזה ודאי גדלות גדולה בשביל הנוקבא, אלא שהיא ו"ק דגדלות, אבל עוד חסר ג"ר דגדלות, והשגת ג"ר דגדלות נק' גדלות ב' של הנוק' וזה יתבאר להלן במאמר מי ברא אלה דאליהו.


For this reason, these brains [of the first maturity] are considered only the six extremities of maturity, ¹³ lacks access to the head of *Arikh Anpin*, due to the presence of the diaphragm at the chest (above the *Nukba*'s new position), this *partzuf* is now six extremities, meaning only having access to the level of light of those lower *sefirot*. since [the *Nukba*] cannot receive the head of maturity, as [the *Nukba*] is below the diaphragm of the chest of *Arikh Anpin*, as stated. However, [*Nukba*] level is now equal to that of *Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna* when [*Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*] is of the level of six extremities, before the ascent of feminine waters, when [*Yisrael Sabba* and *Tevuna*] was positioned from the chest to the navel of *Arikh Anpin*. This is certainly a significant maturity for the *Nukba*, but it is [only] the six extremities of maturity and [the *Nukba*] still lacks the [lights] of the first three [*sefirot*] of maturity. The attainment of the first three of maturity is called “the second maturity of the *Nukba*.” This will be explained below in the section “Who created these, of Elijah.”
